source: CATAAS (Cat as a service) Public API
description: Fetch a public image as a binary stream and save it to the local filesystem without authentication.
nl_goal: I need a placeholder image of a cat for my project UI. Please download a random cat image from the public CATAAS API and save it locally as 'cat_pic.jpg'.

paradigm_3_config.skill_description: A standard tool to download a public image and save it to the local disk as a binary file.
